'''RamapoCon II Constructed (5 May, 3 pm)''' was a Star Wars CCG convention constructed tournament held in Ramapo College, New Jersey on 5 May 2000. [[Charlie Herren]] won it. It is known from Jonny Chu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d694">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapocon-ii-part-1-5-5-2000d694/ ramapocon-ii-part-1-5-5-2000], DeckTech (Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapocon-ii-part-1-5-5-2000d694/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[RamapoCon II]].

* '''Date:''' 5 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Ramapo College, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Charlie Herren]]
